title: Add training model profile bootstrap hook for Ollama parity
description:
Problem: model profile defaults and local Ollama tags drift across local run surfaces, causing repeated manual setup before training A/B comparisons and occasional non-executable defaults.

Desired outcome: provide a scriptable bootstrap path that verifies local Ollama tag availability, creates a stock 24k comparator tag when needed, and writes consistent trained/default + stock comparator model profiles into the resolved settings override file.

Scope:
- In scope: add `Scripts/SkillHooks/Ensure-TrainingModelProfiles.ps1`.
- In scope: resolve settings override path using existing MemorySmith path rules.
- In scope: verify required tags and create `qwen3.5:4b-24k-stock` when missing.
- In scope: write/update profile ids and default safely with warnings when trained tag is unavailable.
- Out of scope: training run execution or model conversion/merge pipelines.

Validation:
- Dry run mode reports intended changes and warnings.
- Real run updates resolved override file with expected profile ids and default id behavior.
- Script emits JSON summary suitable for tracker/task evidence comments.

Confidence target: 92%.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-30 self-review follow-up after recurring model-profile and Ollama tag setup drift during training A/B cycles.
